title: Ground truth: how the shipped app routes language, and where ES/FR enter
headline: A working two-package app-UID runner exists in this repository and has passed physical acceptance. Lane E's BLOCKED_APP_RUNNER_MISSING describes Lane E's own staged bundle, not this repo. ES/FR need seven additive edits: two ASR allow-lists, one companion language switch, one selection branch, one telemetry row, one TTS candidate factory and one auto-priority whitelist.

corrects.why_wrong: android-app/{app,runtime-companion} are checked in, build, and are installed by docs/ANDROID_DEPLOYMENT.md steps 3-4; four probe packages demonstrate the isolated-QNN-process pattern.

asr_routing_before.es_fr_behaviour: fell past the companion gate to LFM2.5-Audio Q4 on 127.0.0.1:8080, CPU, labelled npu_fallback_reason=language_not_supported_by_sensevoice_qnn

input_contract.requirement: 44-byte RIFF header, PCM format 1, mono, 16000 Hz, 16 bit, data length == file bytes - 44
input_contract.consequence_for_lane_f: the Parakeet vendor demo WAVs are 22050/24000 Hz and are rejected as shipped; Lane F resamples them once, offline, before staging

tts_selection.catalog: read at runtime from candidates.json in the pushed tts-eval bundle, not compiled in
tts_selection.supertonic_config_verified_by: javap over sherpa-onnx-1.13.4.aar: seven String fields, no dataDir
